mapper.sql: id, herb_no, herb_name, latin_name, alias_name, category_id, category_code, medicinal_part, efficacy, growth_environment, origin_area, growth_cycle, description, knowledge_entity_id, status, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted

s.id, s.herb_no, s.herb_name, s.latin_name, s.alias_name, s.category_id, s.category_code, COALESCE(category.item_name, s.category_code) AS category_name, s.medicinal_part, s.efficacy, s.growth_environment, s.origin_area, s.growth_cycle, s.description, s.knowledge_entity_id, regions.distribution_region_text, s.status, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.is_deleted

LEFT JOIN dict_type category_type ON category_type.type_code = 'herb_category' AND category_type.status = 1 AND category_type.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN dict_item category ON category.type_id = category_type.id AND category.item_code = s.category_code AND category.status = 1 AND category.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT species_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT district ORDER BY district SEPARATOR '、') AS distribution_region_text FROM herb_distribution WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND district IS NOT NULL AND district != '' GROUP BY species_id ) regions ON regions.species_id = s.id
